name: playwright-js-e2e-framework
description: Playwright JavaScript end-to-end automation framework using the Sauce Demo application.

scripts.test: npm run allure:clean && cross-env ENV=qa playwright test --project=chromium
scripts.test:staging: npm run allure:clean && cross-env ENV=staging playwright test --project=chromium
scripts.test:headed: npm run allure:clean && cross-env ENV=qa playwright test --project=chromium --headed
scripts.test:debug: npm run allure:clean && cross-env ENV=qa playwright test --project=chromium --debug
scripts.test:firefox: npm run allure:clean && cross-env ENV=qa playwright test --project=firefox
scripts.test:webkit: npm run allure:clean && cross-env ENV=qa playwright test --project=webkit
scripts.test:browsers: npm run allure:clean && cross-env ENV=qa playwright test
scripts.test:sanity: npm run allure:clean && cross-env ENV=qa playwright test --project=chromium --grep @sanity
scripts.test:smoke: npm run allure:clean && cross-env ENV=qa playwright test --project=chromium --grep @smoke
scripts.test:critical: npm run allure:clean && cross-env ENV=qa playwright test --project=chromium --grep @critical
scripts.test:auth: npm run allure:clean && cross-env ENV=qa playwright test --project=chromium --grep @auth
scripts.test:regression: npm run allure:clean && cross-env ENV=qa playwright test --project=chromium --grep @regression

author: Ali Hashmi
